newsitem.title: USA: Action Performance buys Image Works Inc.
newsitem.headline: Action Performance buys Image Works Inc.

text.p: Action Performance Companies Inc said it acquired Image Works Inc, a motorsports-related apparel marketing company based in Atlanta.
Action said it purchased certain assets and liabilities of Image Works for $4.25 million with an additional three-year earn-out that could raise the total purchase price to about $6.4 million.
Based in Atlanta, Image Works specializes in nationwide mass retail marketing of NASCAR-licensed apparel through its major distribution channels that include K-Mart and Wal-Mart stores, Action said.
In the 1996 calendar year, Image Works sales were about $20 million, Action said.
